title: params of deploy.request
description: Ask the repository's own build-and-deploy pipeline for a release. Every gate still applies: the verdict, the approval bound to the digest, readiness, the lease, the release block. The API deploys nothing itself, and a request through it needs a human approval on the target environment.

mode.description: promote: move a digest a predecessor verified (KDEC-029; uat and prod only this way). build-deploy: build the default branch and deploy it (dev and test only).

release_path.description: normal or hotfix through the API. rollback and break-glass are accepted by the schema only so that the refusal is named (API_RELEASE_PATH_NOT_PERMITTED).
